title: base/commerce-payments: Onchain authorization and capture for trust-minimized commerce
quote: A permissionless protocol for onchain payments that mimics traditional authorize and capture payment flows. [...] Separate authorization and capture for guaranteed merchant payments [...] Void: Cancel authorizations (operator); Refund: Return captured funds to payers; Charge: Immediate authorization and capture; Reclaim: Recover expired authorizations (payer) [...] Permissionless operators manage payment flows while remaining trust-minimized [...] Support for multiple authorization methods (ERC-3009, Permit2, allowances, spend permissions) [...] Configurable fee rates and recipients within predefined ranges [...] v1.1.0 AuthCaptureEscrow 0xf96815976523E00e65Be8f34cA5e64b4f41EB19c; ERC3009PaymentCollector 0x8612dfdc421f80336cd14E8EF9cb1E765dB5ab88; Permit2PaymentCollector 0xD69831Aed5bfe262067ec4c751f4F830EcdD446e; PreApprovalPaymentCollector 0xF1F9C408C787B2bC6CAEB91e5BbEc434a5c8d2Ea; SpendPermissionPaymentCollector 0xB508c1C0a13849693DC175307667653C5977a408; OperatorRefundCollector 0x7a03443724d14798c4AB4622F1DAAcA761Fea486 [...] Spearbit and Coinbase Protocol Security completed six audits between March and July 2026.

title: Engineering the Commerce Payments Protocol Powering Shopify
quote: The smart contract enforces that if funds are authorized, then they are put on hold to guarantee the ability to capture at a later date. [...] [operators] cannot modify the original payment intent of the payer [...] cannot lock funds in the escrow [...] cannot impact the activities of another operator. [...] Users should not have to trust any operator or managing entity to be safe. [...] A fee-free payer experience is important for conversion

title: Introducing the commerce payments protocol
quote: most onchain payments today work well for peer-to-peer transfers, they fall short of handling the complexity of commercial purchases [...] After buyers approve a payment, funds must be locked while still allowing either part to cancel if needed. [...] Captures can be made in multiple partial increments to support merchants that may fulfill goods in multiple deliveries. [...] cheaper for merchants because they only pay fees on captured payments [...] Coinbase provides an operator service, but the protocol is open for anyone to build their own.
